name: Chou no Miru Yume
source:
Find the blue butterfly.... The lead character Hirano Kazuya meets a beautiful girl at a belvedere. In the big city Tokyo, his journey to find the True World has just begun.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE025571.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
找到那只蓝色蝴蝶…主人公平野和哉在一座观景亭遇见了一位美丽的少女。在东京这座大都市中，他寻找「真实世界」的旅程才刚刚开始。

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE025571.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
